description: I don’t take anything personal , it’s not about me #selflove #maturity #patience
transcript: I do not take anything personal. Most things are not about me. Most equations don't even have my name in it. I focus on what's in front of me. I focus on what I'm doing, and I readjust accordingly. I don't throw myself into equations that I don't exist in to help come up with an answer. Most things are not about me, and that is great.
